criteria.financial: No funding stop or operator arrears; nonnegative earned surplus excluding opening capital and restricted grants; nonnegative final 12-period surplus; closing unrestricted cash >= three periods of operator cost.
criteria.memberCost: Each consumer ever charged an administration fee pays strictly less, including service obligations, administration fees and completed switch charges, than retail for the same contracted service-period basket.
criteria.service: In a matched A0 run, no paying member loses attempted or fulfilled tasks; total unmet demand does not increase.
criteria.limitation: Synthetic conditional outcomes, not empirical probabilities or proof of contributor welfare. Individual maintenance effort/payments and nonmonetary burdens are not established by this engine.
